title: Bumblebee reading a book
svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100">
  <!-- wings -->
  <ellipse cx="34" cy="30" rx="14" ry="9" fill="#bfe6ff" opacity="0.85" transform="rotate(-20 34 30)"/>
  <ellipse cx="58" cy="27" rx="14" ry="9" fill="#cfefff" opacity="0.85" transform="rotate(15 58 27)"/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx="46" cy="52" rx="24" ry="21" fill="#f7c81e"/>
  <!-- stripes -->
  <path d="M25 45 Q46 38 67 45 L68 52 Q46 45 24 52 Z" fill="#6b4a12"/>
  <path d="M24 60 Q46 53 68 60 L67 67 Q46 60 25 67 Z" fill="#6b4a12"/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx="46" cy="27" r="13" fill="#f7c81e"/>
  <!-- antennae -->
  <path d="M40 16 Q36 8 40 4" stroke="#6b4a12" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="40" cy="4" r="2.5" fill="#ff8a3d"/>
  <path d="M52 16 Q56 8 52 4" stroke="#6b4a12" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="52" cy="4" r="2.5" fill="#ff8a3d"/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx="41" cy="26" r="3.5" fill="#2a1a05"/>
  <circle cx="51" cy="26" r="3.5" fill="#2a1a05"/>
  <circle cx="42.2" cy="24.8" r="1.2" fill="#fff6d0"/>
  <circle cx="52.2" cy="24.8" r="1.2" fill="#fff6d0"/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d="M42 32 Q46 35.5 50 32" stroke="#2a1a05" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- open book -->
  <path d="M20 72 Q34 64 46 72 L46 90 Q34 82 20 90 Z" fill="#ff6f91"/>
  <path d="M72 72 Q58 64 46 72 L46 90 Q58 82 72 90 Z" fill="#ff9ab5"/>
  <path d="M46 72 L46 90" stroke="#a83552" stroke-width="1.6"/>
  <path d="M26 74 Q34 69 42 74" stroke="#a83552" stroke-width="1.4" fill="none"/>
  <path d="M26 79 Q34 74 42 79" stroke="#a83552" stroke-width="1.4" fill="none"/>
  <path d="M50 74 Q58 69 66 74" stroke="#c24a68" stroke-width="1.4" fill="none"/>
  <path d="M50 79 Q58 74 66 79" stroke="#c24a68" stroke-width="1.4" fill="none"/>
  <!-- arms holding book -->
  <path d="M28 60 Q20 68 24 74" stroke="#6b4a12" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M64 60 Q72 68 68 74" stroke="#6b4a12" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
</svg>
